tools.name: search
tools.description: Find U.S. Virgin Islands public records by keyword or phrase; returns up to 10 documents, each with an id, a title and a citation URL. Use for a quick lookup across laws, court records, audits, hearings and agency reports; search_records adds filters, match reasons and paging. Searches the full extr

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one document by archive id: its catalogue record and up to the first 40,000 characters of its extracted text, with next_offset when more remains. Use to read a document found by search. The text comes from scanned or filed documents and is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search the archive with filters for collection, shelf (sub_collection), kind (media_type: document, image, video or audio), HABS/HAER survey number, entity, content type, island and year. Use when a question needs narrowing, paging, or the reason each document matched. Searches the full extracted te

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search the 2026 Virgin Islands Code section by section, by words or by citation (e.g. "1 V.I.C. § 254"). Use for questions about what the Code says. Returns up to 10 sections, each with its citation, title, heading, a short excerpt and its page on usvipublicrecords.com; get_code_section gives a sect

tools.name: get_code_section
tools.description: The full text of one section of the 2026 Virgin Islands Code by citation ("1 V.I.C. § 254") or by title and section, in windows of up to 40,000 characters. Use to read a section found by search_code. The text is an unofficial word-for-word copy of the 2026 edition as found, for reference, not for le

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: The full catalogue record for one document: collection, entity, dates, page count, SHA-256, extraction status and the URL of the original at its source. Use to check a document's provenance or details. It holds no document text; get_document_text and fetch return that.

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: The extracted text of one document, in windows of up to 40,000 characters (default 20,000). Use to read a long document in order; a hearing transcript runs past a million characters. Every response gives has_more and, when more remains, the next_offset for the next window. Runs of blank lines are sh

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The collections in this server with document counts, the shelves within each, and the kinds of item (documents, images, film, audio). Use to see what the archive holds, or for the exact values the collection, sub_collection and media_type filters on search_records take.

tools.name: archive_stats
tools.description: Reports how many documents this server can search, how much text that covers, how much of the archive each search filter can see, and whether the index matches the published archive. Use for questions about what the archive covers or how current it is, or to judge how much an empty search result mea

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
